prompt_template: Latitude: {lat:.1f}, Longitude: {lon:.1f}. Predict the surface type (Solid or Water) and terrain elevation in meters relative to mean sea level (EGM2008). Solid includes land and grounded ice: report bare-ground elevation, or the ice-surface elevation on grounded ice. Water includes oceans, lakes, and floating ice shelves: report the seabed or lakebed elevation, NOT the water or floating-ice surface elevation. Underwater terrain below sea level has a negative elevation. Ignore buildings, vegetation, and temporary sea ice. Reply with exactly one JSON object with two fields: "type" ("Solid" or "Water") and "elevation_m" (a single number in meters, not a range).
sampling: all original 16,200 grid centers; no coordinate exclusions

height_reference.name: NOAA ETOPO 2022
height_reference.interpolation: bilinear mean of four surrounding native cells
height_reference.unscorable_policy: lakes, floating ice shelves, nested islands, known classification disagreements and water/nonnegative-height conflicts; requests and classification remain included

classification_reference.name: GSHHG
classification_reference.resolution: Full-resolution vector polygons; variable source accuracy
classification_reference.limitation: Static coast/lake boundaries with older source surveys. Narrow rivers, seasonal water, shoreline changes and boundary positions remain uncertain; not absolute ground truth.
